title: RETA - Model Specification v1.0.0
abstract_en: Specification of a deterministic synthetic research model with proposed outputs, audits, gates and postmortems in a causal graph. Evaluation uses five tensions, six uncertainty categories, finite audit budgets and prospective lens versions. Browser playback reuses a 180-event trace. Practical usefulness, empirical safety and alignment are unestablished.
abstract_fr: Spécification d’un modèle synthétique déterministe : événements, audits, décisions et retours d’expérience; cinq tensions, six incertitudes et versions prospectives de la grille. La présentation rejoue 180 événements. Prototype non calibré, sans preuve d’alignement ou de sécurité empirique.
provenance: Report 2 clarifies claims in the supplied v1.0.0 specification after code inspection and reruns of its synthetic component checks. The equations, engine and scientific data are unchanged. AI assistance was used for this editorial review and presentation. These are same-implementation software checks, not independent scientific replication, peer review or evidence of real-world alignment. Original report 1 and a correction record remain available.
